author: ReTrace
description: Live debugger control via the x64dbg HTTP plugin. Attached to a running process.

tools.name: BreakAndInspect
tools.capability: Set a SOFTWARE breakpoint at `addr` (a sink or call site), run until it is ACTUALLY hit, then

tools.name: BreakAtApiAndInspect
tools.capability: Resolve an imported API (e.g. module="kernel32.dll", api="CreateProcessA"), set a SOFTWARE

tools.name: DebugDeleteBreakpoint
tools.capability: Delete breakpoint at address using Script API

tools.name: DebugPause
tools.capability: Pause execution of the debugged process using Script API

tools.name: DebugRun
tools.capability: Resume execution of the debugged process using Script API

tools.name: DebugSetBreakpoint
tools.capability: Set breakpoint at address using Script API

tools.name: DebugStepIn
tools.capability: Step into the next instruction using Script API

tools.name: DebugStepOut
tools.capability: Step out of the current function using Script API

tools.name: DebugStepOver
tools.capability: Step over the next instruction using Script API

tools.name: DebugStop
tools.capability: Stop debugging using Script API

tools.name: DeleteHardwareBreakpoint
tools.capability: Delete a hardware breakpoint at the specified address.

tools.name: DisasmGetInstructionRange
tools.capability: Get disassembly of multiple instructions starting at the specified address

tools.name: EnumHandles
tools.capability: Enumerate all open handles in the debugged process.

tools.name: EnumTcpConnections
tools.capability: Enumerate all TCP connections of the debugged process.

tools.name: ExecCommand
tools.capability: Execute a command in x64dbg and return its output

tools.name: GetBranchDestination
tools.capability: Get the destination address of a branch instruction (jmp, call, jcc, etc.).

tools.name: GetBreakpointList
tools.capability: Get list of all breakpoints currently set in the debugger.

tools.name: GetCallStack
tools.capability: Get the current call stack of the debugged thread.

tools.name: GetMemoryMap
tools.capability: Get the full virtual memory map of the debugged process.

tools.name: GetModuleList
tools.capability: Get list of loaded modules.

tools.name: GetRegisterDump
tools.capability: Get a complete dump of all CPU registers in one call.

tools.name: GetThreadList
tools.capability: Get list of all threads in the debugged process with detailed information.

tools.name: MemoryBase
tools.capability: Find the base address and size of a module containing the given address

tools.name: MemoryGetProtect
tools.capability: Get memory protection flags

tools.name: MemoryRead
tools.capability: Read memory using enhanced Script API

tools.name: MemoryWrite
tools.capability: Write memory using enhanced Script API

tools.name: MiscParseExpression
tools.capability: Parse expression using Script API (numeric / duint result only NO STRINGS).

tools.name: MiscRemoteGetProcAddress
tools.capability: Get remote procedure address using Script API

tools.name: PatternFindMem
tools.capability: Find pattern in memory using Script API

tools.name: QuerySymbols
tools.capability: Enumerate symbols for a specific module. Use GetModuleList first to discover module names.

tools.name: ReadCallArguments
tools.capability: At the CURRENT break (e.g. right after entering a function), read the first `count` call

tools.name: ReadStringSmart
tools.capability: Read a string at an address: try x64dbg's own detection first, then decode raw memory as

tools.name: RegisterGet
tools.capability: Get register value using Script API

tools.name: RegisterSet
tools.capability: Set register value using Script API

tools.name: SetHardwareBreakpoint
tools.capability: Set a hardware breakpoint at the specified address.

tools.name: StringGetAt
tools.capability: Retrieve the string at a given address in the debugged process.

tools.name: WaitForBreak
tools.capability: Block until the debuggee is actually PAUSED (breakpoint hit), or the timeout expires.

tools.name: XrefGet
tools.capability: Get all cross-references (xrefs) TO the specified address.

tools.name: x64dbg_state
tools.capability: THE single tool for "what is the debuggee doing right now": alive or not, running or paused,

tools.name: x64dbg_wait_for_exit
tools.capability: Poll for confirmed process exit. Timeout returns state=timeout, not terminated.
